text: How to ask her out on a second date? Let's say you already had a first date with a girl. And let's say it was not perfect. Maybe it lacked physical touch. You wanted but was afraid to kiss her. Or maybe the vibe wasn't 10 out of 10. Now you are stuck thinking, how do I ask her out again? What if she will not want to see me again? What should I say? Here is the answer. Do not overthink it. Do not rewrite the dating rule book. Use the same kind of message you used the first time. It can be as simple as, hey, how does your schedule look like this week? Are you free on the weekend? Say, Friday or Saturday? How about we get a drink at a bar somewhere in a city center? That's it. Nothing too complicated. You don't need to get creative. You don't need a poetic second date invite. If the first date was decent, she will say yes. No magic words needed. And if she did not like the first date, no matter what you write in your invitation, she most likely will not agree to meet. Second dates are based on how she felt during the first one. If she enjoyed it, she will be glad to see you again. So do not overcomplicate it. Just ask.
